episode_title: 200. Rätt tajming för ny mikrobolagsfond, Oscar Karlsson?

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Oskar Karlsson discusses Embracer as an example of a compounder that has performed well within its niche, but notes that the compounder model is facing challenges in the current rising rate environment. He contrasts Embracer with perennial compounders like Assa Abloy and Atlas Copco.

quotes.speaker: Oskar Karlsson
quotes.text: Ja men inom sin nisch får man nog ändå säga att det har varit det hittills.

quotes.speaker: Oskar Karlsson
quotes.text: När du har haft ett årtionde avfallande räntor så blir det ju så att compounders blir någonting som är ett vinnande fenomen. Under den perioden. Och när du får ett sentimentskifte i det då blir det svårare att vara compounder.

quotes.speaker: Oskar Karlsson
quotes.text: Men med det sagt så finns det ju alltid bolag av den högsta kvaliteten som alltid har varit compounders över tid. Kollar man Assa, Kollar man Atlas Copco, de har ju haft en förmåga att sätta sin sits där de kan fortsätta göra förvärv även i svagare tider.

bull_case: Has been a successful compounder within its gaming niche
bear_case: Compounder model becomes harder in rising rate environments
Intensiteten i transaktionerna kommer inte att vara lika hög på väldigt länge
risks: Change in market sentiment toward growth/compounder strategies

summary: Oskar Karlsson from Enter Fonder discusses the launch of their new Enter Microcap fund, which is starting January 2nd. He explains his investment philosophy focusing on quality microcaps with strong balance sheets, double-digit margins, 10-15% growth, and pricing power. He discusses themes like digitalization of the real economy, on-shoring of production, and sustainability transition. He notes that the current market conditions with depressed valuations and liquidity present a good long-term entry point for microcaps.
key_takeaways: Enter Microcap fond starts January 2nd with focus on quality companies over 1 billion SEK market cap
Look for companies with 10-15% margins, 10-15% growth, strong balance sheets and pricing power
Key investment themes: digitalization of real economy, on-shoring trend, sustainability transition
Current market with depressed valuations and liquidity presents good long-term entry point
Compounder model will be more challenging in rising rate environment
